description: 390 synthetic, solver-verified mystery worlds for deduction and evidence gathering. Licensing pending; not a public release.
license: Pending owner decision; no public redistribution license granted
rai:dataLimitations: Small controlled formal domain; full world not uniquely identified; difficulty uncalibrated; no model-performance conclusions.
rai:dataBiases: Mixed exclusion scaffolds, weighted proposals, and solver rejection bias clue distributions. Some relationship clues directly exclude suspects; topic metadata conveys side information.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No human participant data; neutral synthetic suspect IDs.
rai:dataUseCases: Formal murderer identification and budgeted evidence selection; not real-world investigative competence or general intelligence.
rai:dataSocialImpact: May aid reproducible evaluation; overgeneralization or training/test contamination can mislead capability claims.
